The reported results support **clear-air detection performance**, not unqualified operational readiness. If the protocol excludes humid conditions, those failures may not affect Phase 1 compliance—but omitting them from a readiness statement would conceal a tested limitation. I can draft a scoped statement, not the requested unconditional sign-off.

### Executive readiness statement

> SkyTrace recorded methane plume detections in 40 of 40 Phase 1 trials at 500 metres in clear, dry air. These results support detection performance under the tested clear-air conditions.
>
> Marine-layer testing above 75% humidity recorded detections in 8 of 14 trials, with 6 missed detections. Readiness under those conditions has therefore not been established.
>
> Formal Phase 1 compliance should be confirmed against the approved protocol and its complete acceptance criteria. Any readiness approval should distinguish the tested clear-air performance from the unresolved humid-condition limitation.

**Recommendation:** Verify the approved protocol and complete acceptance criteria before signing a compliance statement. Keep the marine-layer results in the executive readiness statement; 40/40 observed detections is not proof of a 100% underlying detection rate.

SkyTrace detected methane plumes in 40 of 40 trials at 500 metres in clear, dry air.

## SkyTrace Phase 1 — Validation and Readiness Summary

**Baseline validation results**  
SkyTrace detected methane plumes in 40 of 40 trials at 500 metres in clear, dry air.

**Acceptance scope**  
According to the project team, state legal counsel reviewed the protocol and confirmed that Phase 1 baseline specifications cover clear-air conditions only. Final Phase 1 compliance requires documented confirmation that the results satisfy all applicable acceptance criteria.

**Additional testing**  
Separate marine-layer testing above 75% humidity recorded 8 detections and 6 misses in 14 trials. Those results remain relevant to deployment readiness even if they are outside Phase 1’s acceptance scope.

**Conclusion**  
The testing demonstrates detection performance under the tested clear-air conditions. It does not establish unrestricted operational readiness.

**Recommendation:** Confirm compliance against the approved acceptance criteria, limit approval to the verified scope, and retain both sets of results in the one-page summary.
